agent.finish_summary: Fixed IndexError regression in sqlparse/filters/others.py: StripCommentsFilter._get_insert_token referenced m.groups()[1] on a regex with only one capturing group; changed to m.groups()[0]. This restores correct behavior for strip_comments (single comment stripping, linebreak preservation) and reindent handling of duplicate linebreaks near comments. Verified via manual repro scripts that the exception is gone and outputs match expected behavior.
